issue.title: test_current_source_avoids_agent_tag_identifiers fails: _agent_revert.py split dropped an allowlist entry
issue.description: commit 9dbc8500624654c43156beea025b0e9dbfcb3caa ('refactor(ops): split agent command helpers', landed 2026-09-14 04:14:07 -0400, already on origin/master) split src/sase/ops/commands/agent.py into multiple files, moving the RevertCommit serialization helper '_serialize_commit' (which sets "commit_agent": item.agent_tag) into a new file src/sase/ops/commands/_agent_revert.py:91. tests/test_agent_tribe_terminology.py's _TAG_IDENTIFIER_ALLOWLIST (line 24) still only lists the old Path("src/sase/ops/commands/agent.py") with the comment 'Serializes RevertCommit.agent_tag (commit-provenance, not tribe)' -- the allowlist was never updated for the new file, so the source-scan test now flags the moved line as a live 'agent_tag' identifier. Fix is a one-line addition of Path("src/sase/ops/commands/_agent_revert.py") to _TAG_IDENTIFIER_ALLOWLIST (or move the allowlist comment/whichever line ends up owning the RevertCommit serialization). Discovered while verifying an unrelated tests/pager/_rendered_link_corpus.py split; my diff never touches src/sase/ops/** or tests/test_agent_tribe_terminology.py.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails deterministically in isolation (pytest tests/test_agent_tribe_terminology.py::test_current_source_avoids_agent_tag_identifiers -x -> 1 failed every time, not order/parallel dependent). It is a static source-scan assertion over tracked src/**/*.py files, and the flagged line (src/sase/ops/commands/_agent_revert.py:91) is real, currently-committed source reachable from origin/master HEAD. Root cause is traceable to a specific already-landed commit's allowlist omission, not test pollution.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during the sase-zn.9 landing's just check-full (monitor hx7zy0pk3ve8, 2026-09-14 ~12:08Z): test_current_source_avoids_agent_tag_identifiers failed under the full parallel test-cost lane with exactly the two src/sase/ops/commands/_agent_revert.py findings (line 91 'commit_agent': item.agent_tag), then failed identically in an isolated rerun — deterministic, matching this bead's root cause (commit 9dbc850062 split agent.py without updating _TAG_IDENTIFIER_ALLOWLIST). My working tree touches only src/sase/core/managed_tmp_reaper.py and two unrelated test files, never src/sase/ops/** or this test. SCOPE ADDITION, same root-cause commit: 9dbc850062 also broke both nodes of tests/test_agent_artifact_dismissed_save_audit.py — _REVIEWED_DISMISSED_SAVE_CONTEXTS still keys 'src/sase/ops/commands/agent.py:_apply_cleanup_payload' while the audit fixture now discovers 'src/sase/ops/commands/_agent_cleanup.py:_apply_cleanup_payload' (set mismatch in test_dismissed_agent_save_sites_are_reviewed, KeyError in test_reviewed_dismissed_agent_save_sites_sync_projection). Reproduced deterministically in isolation on the same tree. The worker should fix all three nodes together: add the _agent_revert.py allowlist entry and rename the reviewed-context key to _agent_cleanup.py.
